name: tabula-game-files
description: Highlighting and live checks for Tabula .game files (board and card game rules).

tabula.path.markdownDescription: The `tabula` command. Leave as is if `tabula` works in a terminal; otherwise the full path to `tabula.exe`, or `python` together with `#tabula.extraArgs#`.

tabula.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments put before `check`, e.g. `["${workspaceFolder}/cli/tabula.py"]` with `#tabula.path#` set to `python`.

tabula.vault.markdownDescription: The vault folder. Empty: found from the file (the folder with `vault.yaml`, or the folder around the game's folder). `${workspaceFolder}` works.

enumDescriptions: Check while typing (after a short pause)
Check only when the file is saved

tabula.delay.description: Pause after typing before checking, in milliseconds.

tabula.requireDefinitions.markdownDescription: Every component must also have a glossary definition (like `tabula check -d`).
